entries.title: Read, answer and choose on a card from the keyboard
entries.body: Once F6 lands on a card, the arrow and page keys scroll it, and ⌘K finds Go to the card's body and Go to the card's buttons. A card's pictures are Tab stops that Enter opens, and a task key the keyboard reaches opens its summary as resting the pointer does. When ⌘K or a picture closes, you're back in the card's field you were typing in, cursor and all, and Escape takes you out of a card's body.

picture.alt: A card with the keyboard on a task key in its words, the key ringed and the task's summary open beside the card
